picks.name: DeepSeek-Reasonix
picks.description: DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for your terminal. Engineered around prefix-cache stability — leave it running.
picks.reason: 按 prefix-cache 写长跑：compact.go 只在窗口 80% 才压、留 16% 原文尾巴，compaction 指令是唯一新消息好让 KV cache 复用；cache_shape.go 哈希 system/tools/prefix 解释 cache miss。这周刚把工具参数错误改成可恢复。适合对着 Go 读「会不会把 cache 打穿」。

picks.name: serena
picks.description: A powerful MCP toolkit for coding, providing semantic retrieval and editing capabilities  - the IDE for your agent
picks.reason: 不是再包一层聊天 MCP：symbol_tools.py 用 SolidLSP 做符号总览和符号级编辑，mcp.py 把工具 schema 洗成 Codex 能吃的 OpenAI 形态。这周还在修 document symbol 缓存和 Kotlin 多实例 LSP 隔离。适合对照静态 AST 图，看「活的语言服务器当 Agent IDE」怎么落地。

picks.name: harbor
picks.description: Framework for evaluating and improving agents
picks.reason: Terminal-Bench 作者的评测框架。trial.py 的 Trial ABC 管 setup/teardown/hooks，adapters/ 里 80+ 套题，`harbor run --dataset terminal-bench@2.0 --agent claude-code` 就能在 Docker 或 Daytona 并行跑。这周加了 Hub agent catalog，还在给 swe-agent 开 completion_kwargs。适合看「评别人家的 Agent」怎么做成可复现环境。

picks.name: open-multi-agent
picks.description: TypeScript multi-agent framework that runs in your own environment: consequential actions wait for approval and every run leaves a verifiable record. Describe the goal, not the graph. 13 built-in providers (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek and more) plus any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, local models included.
picks.reason: TypeScript 里「先写目标、运行时再拆 DAG」。coordinator.ts 解析任务 JSON（verify judges 不进模型输出），scheduler.ts 默认 dependency-first，consequential.ts 只看 tool.consequential 元数据决定是否拦下，prompt/参数故意不参与分类。`npm create oma-app` 有无 key 的脚本化 demo。适合看审批和调度怎么写成可回放记录。

picks.name: loopx
picks.description: Long-horizon agent control plane for durable, governed work across Codex, Claude Code, and other harnesses.
picks.reason: 不替代 Codex/Claude Code，只在上面做长程控制面。coordination/todo_claim.ts 用 schema 化 decision/receipt 原子认领 Todo，带 lease 和 dry_run。这周刚合入 native todo ownership transaction，还有 Agent 授权的 typed periodic report。适合看「harness 只干一截、目标/配额/交接留在控制面」怎么拆。
